description: Start a short hands-on lab that fixes one vulnerability in realistic AI-generated code. Call this when the user wants to learn how to fix a finding, or after review_code reports a finding with a lab. Pass a lab id (lab-02-sqli) or a finding id (CODE-SQLI-001). Then help the user fix the snippet and submit it with check_lab.

finding_id.description: Finding id; the matching lab is opened.

lab_id.description: Lab id, e.g. lab-02-sqli. Omit to list labs.

name: start_lab
title: Start a 5-minute secure-coding lab
